name: AWS IAM Access Key Created
description: Successful aws iam access key created; behavioral signal, not proof of malicious intent. Raw provider field contract; synthetic tests only.

name: Synthetic AWS IAM AdministratorAccess Policy Attachment
description: Successful attachment of AWS managed AdministratorAccess to an IAM user, group or role. Synthetic lab only.
query: (eventSource:iam.amazonaws.com AND (eventName:(AttachUserPolicy OR AttachRolePolicy OR AttachGroupPolicy)) AND requestParameters.policyArn:arn\:aws\:iam\:\:aws\:policy\/AdministratorAccess) AND (NOT _exists_:errorCode)

name: AWS CloudTrail Trail Deleted
description: Successful aws cloudtrail trail deleted; behavioral signal, not proof of malicious intent. Raw provider field contract; synthetic tests only.

name: AWS CloudTrail Logging Stopped
description: Successful aws cloudtrail logging stopped; behavioral signal, not proof of malicious intent. Raw provider field contract; synthetic tests only.

name: AWS Successful Console Login Without MFA
description: Successful aws successful console login without mfa; behavioral signal, not proof of malicious intent. Raw provider field contract; synthetic tests only.
query: (eventSource:signin.amazonaws.com AND eventName:ConsoleLogin AND responseElements.ConsoleLogin:Success AND additionalEventData.MFAUsed:No) AND (NOT _exists_:errorCode)

name: Entra Application Credential Added
description: Successful entra application credential added; behavioral signal, not proof of malicious intent. Raw provider field contract; synthetic tests only.
query: category:ApplicationManagement AND activityDisplayName:"Add service principal credentials" AND loggedByService:"Core Directory" AND result:success

name: Entra App Role Assigned To Service Principal
description: Successful app role assignment to a service principal in directory audit logs. Behavioral signal for privilege escalation through an application identity, not proof of malicious intent.
query: category:ApplicationManagement AND activityDisplayName:"Add app role assignment to service principal" AND loggedByService:"Core Directory" AND result:success

name: Entra Conditional Access Policy Deleted
description: Successful entra conditional access policy deleted; behavioral signal, not proof of malicious intent. Raw provider field contract; synthetic tests only.
query: category:Policy AND activityDisplayName:"Delete conditional access policy" AND loggedByService:"Core Directory" AND result:success

name: Entra Application Consent Or Delegated Permission Granted
description: Successful user or admin consent to an application, or a delegated permission grant, in directory audit logs. Illicit consent is a known token-theft path; treat as a signal and verify the app and the permissions.
query: category:ApplicationManagement AND (activityDisplayName:("Consent to application" OR "Add delegated permission grant")) AND loggedByService:"Core Directory" AND result:success

name: Entra Directory Role Member Added
description: Successful entra directory role member added; behavioral signal, not proof of malicious intent. Raw provider field contract; synthetic tests only.
query: category:RoleManagement AND activityDisplayName:"Add member to role" AND loggedByService:"Core Directory" AND result:success

name: Entra New User Account Created
description: Successful creation of a new user in the directory. Combine with a role assignment to spot a new administrator account; on its own it is a low-fidelity signal.
query: category:UserManagement AND activityDisplayName:"Add user" AND loggedByService:"Core Directory" AND result:success
